nom: 9 Pack Animal Face Masks Skincare for Kids

avis.titre: Adorable animal face masks with sensitive skin friendly ingredients
avis.texte: Adorable!!! My toddler was obsessed and we had a blast with these. I gradients appear clean and good for sensitive skin. So cute the designs. Must get ! You won’t regret! Seemed to moisturize my face some but no significant differences noticed only used 1 time though. The animal faces make it worth it regardless of any results for the price it’s worth it! These adorable face masks were a hit with my toddler, and we had a great time using them. The gradients appear clean and suitable for sensitive skin. The cute animal designs are a bonus. U must get these! You won’t regret it. They seemed to moisturize my face slightly, but I only used them once. Regardless of the results, the animal faces make them worth the price.

Cute animal print masks. Took one star off because the masks are a little too big and difficult to peel apart to apply to face. Definitely too big for kids’ faces but they wanted a spa day so we made it work. No off putting smells and didn’t cause any rashes on my wife’s or kids’ sensitive skin. Effective in making skin feel soft and refreshed. Great quality item to add every once in a while to your skin care routine.
These are so fun! They make a great gift! My 9y.o. loved it :)
These are so cute!! My daughter is 9 and loves them. Perfect for sleep overs or spa days. Or just for fun. Although they work really well to so don’t wanna waste them either lol
Not kid size. I’m a woman and they were just a bit bigger than me. But the designs are cute.

avis.titre: Soft masks for my princess spa party with cute little characters to choose from
avis.texte: The girls loved having these at their princess spa party. It was easy for them to place it on their faces. They said it felt good on their skin and it was soft. They loved the different fun characters they had to choose from too. They all Looked so cute as they giggled when they looked at each other. Fun!

avis.titre: Great but for your kiddos. Doesn’t have all the toxins either
avis.texte: These are the cutest and a great buy! My kids absolutely have a blast (even my son) using these.

Purchased for my daughter so she can do face masks with me. The masks are true to the pictures and some made us giggle. The masks have a ton of product on it. My daughter has sensitive skin and very happy to say she’s never had a reaction to it. The value for money is worth it!
